metadata.title: Secure Storage IoMT Overlay SSPP
metadata.remarks: Applies Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) constraints to secure storage systems handling clinical, diagnostic, and patient-related data.

import-profile.remarks: This overlay applies the strictest constraints due to patient safety, regulatory, and privacy obligations.

pattern-bindings.remarks: Applies healthcare and patient-safety constraints across all secure storage capabilities.

system-characteristics.system-description: Storage environments supporting medical devices, clinical systems, and patient data.

props.name: storage-environment
props.remarks: Identifies this storage as supporting IoMT and clinical workloads.

props.name: data-criticality
props.remarks: Compromise or loss of data may directly impact patient safety.

props.name: immutability-requirement
props.remarks: All clinical data SHALL be immutable for the duration of mandated retention.

props.name: encryption-exception-policy
props.remarks: No cryptographic exceptions are allowed for IoMT storage.

props.name: telemetry-retention
props.remarks: Telemetry and audit records SHALL be retained beyond minimum regulatory periods.

system-implementation.remarks: IoMT storage SHALL favor patient safety, evidentiary integrity, and regulatory compliance above availability or operational convenience.

prohibited-operational-actions.statement: Irreversible data destruction SHALL NOT occur without documented regulatory and governance approval.

escalation-requirements.statement: Any IoMT storage violation SHALL escalate immediately to governance, clinical leadership, and SecOps.

back-matter.remarks: This overlay defines the highest storage assurance tier. No subordinate overlay may relax these constraints.
